business.about: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited,  incorporated  in  1993 ,  is  a  Electronic  Manufacturing  Services  (EMS)  company  with operations in the electronic products vertical such as consumer electronics, lighting, home appliance, closed-circuit television cameras  (CCTVs), and mobile  phones. It also  undertakes reverse logistics operations.  Besides, it manufactures security surveillance equipment, wearables & audibles, AC-PCBs. Recently, it has entered a JV with Imagine Marketing Private Limited for designing and manufacturing wireless audio solutions in India. [1]

promises.opening: welcome to the Dixon Technologies Q2 FY '27 Earnings Conference Call, hosted by DAM Capital Advisors. As a reminder, all participant lines will be in the listen-only mode and there will be an opportunity for you to ask questions after the presentation concludes. Should you need assistance during the conference call, please signal an operator by pressing star then zero on your touchtone phone. Please note that this call is being recorded. I now hand the conference over to Mr. Tanay Shah from DAM Capital Advisors. Thank you, and over to you. Tanay Shah: Thank you. Good evening, everyone, and welcome to Dixon's Q2 FY '27 Earnings Call. Today, we have with us the management being represented by Mr. Atul Lall, Vice Chairman and Managing Director, and Mr. Saurabh Gupta, Director and Group CFO. At this point, I will hand over the floor to Atul sir for his opening remarks, post which we will open up the floor for Q&A. Thank you, and over to you, sir. Atul Lall: Thanks, Tanay. Thank you so much. Good evening, everyone. This is Atul Lall, and joining me today is our Director and Group CFO, Saurabh Gupta. Saurabh Gupta: Good evening, everybody. Atul Lall: I would like to warmly welcome all our stakeholders to discuss our Q2 performance for Financial Year '26-'27. Key highlights for the quarter are as below: Revenues for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 was INR 21,806 crores. EBITDA excluding fair value gain on the stake held by Dixon in Aditya Infotech Limited for the quarter was INR 609 crores. PAT after minority interest and excluding fair value gain on the stake held by Dixon and Aditya Infotech Limited for the quarter was INR 293 crores. Margins during the quarter were impacted on expiration of mobile PLI 1 scheme along with elevated global memory prices due to rapid expansion of AI infrastructure. The pass-through of higher input cost through corresponding increasing in selling prices resulted in a lower reported margin percentage, particularly in mobile and IT hardware business, despite the recovery of increased cost through pricing adjustments. Our mobile business has remained resilient, sustaining volumes at broadly stable year-on-year levels, despite the challenging operating environment. Exports volumes for our anchor customer is expected to ramp up meaningfully from Q4, with further growth anticipated along with exports of feature phones and smartphones, exports of Transsion Group's brands from the next fiscal. Dixon Technologies (India) Limited October 30, 2026 Page 3 of 23 Profitability in washing machine and refrigerator was temporarily affected by fluctuations in polymer prices, rising freight costs and transit time, unfavorable foreign exchange movement, and higher cost of other key inputs. These pressures are expected to ease as cost pass-through initiatives gain traction and operational efficiencies progressively strengthen. During the quarter, we also undertook calibrated pricing actions in response to the sharp rise in input cost. However, with the continued increase in prices, there is always a lag in passing off the same. Near-term external headwinds do not alter our medium to long-term growth story, and we continue to see strong opportunities for increasing localization, deepening of manufacturing, new customer additions, and India's growing position in the global electronics manufacturing ecosystem. Our strategic foray into display modules, camera modules, mechanicals, and other critical components represent a significant step in Dixon's evolution from a scaled electronics manufacturing services player to more deeply integrated electronics manufacturing ecosystem. By building capabilities across critical components, we aim to enhance domestic value addition, strengthen supply chain resilience, improve cost competitiveness, and deepen customer engagement, and progressively unlock opportunities for margin expansion, thereby strengthening Dixon's comparative moat of sustainable growth.
